title: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_2020-35 has the short title and, in its s.1 footnote, '21st day of November, 2025 --- vide Notification No. S.O. 5320(E), dated 21st November, 2025'.
notes: Covers retrenchment, lay-off, closure and retrenchment compensation. Replaces the Industrial Disputes Act 1947, Trade Unions Act 1926 and Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act 1946.
